name: H5 Data Centers Ashburn

profile.reading: This facility is attributed to H5 Data Centers, which describes itself on its own site as a national provider of wholesale data centers and colocation services, operating across 25 United States markets with more than 4 million square feet of facilities. The company own site names Seattle, Washington; Portland, Oregon; San Antonio, Texas; and Ashburn, Virginia among its data center and colocation locations, matching every state where this registry lists an H5 Data Centers facility, alongside other hubs including Phoenix, Chicago, Denver, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Buffalo, Atlanta, and New York. The company states it recently acquired Tampa, Nashville, and Buffalo locations from 365 Data Centers, and describes more than 250 years of combined employee experience in building and managing data centers. No founding date, headquarters address, ownership structure, and no building specific address or individual MW figures for this particular registry row, were located in available sourcing this session.
profile.research_note: Market presence confirmed via operator own site; founding, ownership, and building-specific detail not confirmed this session. This registry also separately lists an H5 operator record (3 facilities), very likely the same company under a shortened name; flagged for reconciliation. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget.
